events.speaker: MODESTY
events.text: Hold still eleven seconds. Not eight, not ten. Blink and you come out with two faces, and I have neither the plates nor the temper to do it again. Mind the case by your boot while you sit.

events.speaker: MODESTY
events.text: There you are, and only you. Nothing in the doorway, nothing standing behind the chair. People are always a little disappointed by that. I never am. I photograph what was there.

events.speaker: MODESTY
events.text: Four counties have told me to put the camera away. Tell me I may point it wherever I please and I'll ride with you as long as the plates hold out.

events.speaker: MODESTY
events.text: I am nearly always behind the lens, which is the only side of it I care to be looked at from. I have a plate of you now. I have taken it out and studied it oftener than the work requires.
